_about: Jumping Jim data extracted from the ZX Spectrum Next version. See docs/game-spec.md for the meaning of every field.

enemy.index: variant*16 + kind*2 + frame (3 colour variants, 8 kinds, 2 frames)

levels.note: palette index = (level-1) & 7; colours are Spectrum attributes

sound.tunes_note: rows of 4 bytes: noteA, noteB, noteC (0=off, 0xFF=hold, n=note index), drum

sample.note: each nibble n plays AY volumes ay_volume_table[n] on channels A,B,C

title_logo.note: segment: x, y, length, direction (0 right,1 down,2 down-right,3 down-left), fly-in dx, dy (signed, shifted right by the logo level). Drawn 2 px thick into a 256x48 buffer.
